title: Automation production readiness: separate bounded trusted-host and Challenge wake tasks

conditions.description: Create a distinct P0 task (not W23 proof or W16 disposable B2) for a default-off, non-sending production HOST TRUST read/verification seam. Accepted-only d312f1cc83685e781ce69e57ad0d4bf613bfb843: Client/Modules/NativeSchedulerAccountReservation.fs:395-402 public reserve/read hard-HOLD; only internal readVerifiedDisposable/reserveVerifiedDisposable depend on disposable coverage. Client production has no NativeSchedulerAccountReservation. callsite, and NativeSchedulerRosterPolicy.fs:58-59 explicitly states signed roster alone cannot authorize sessions. Task must source-bind authenticated account operator/session/device and complete current account + member project Git-head/roster/occupancy evidence without caller-asserted coverage, reject stale/unknown/revoked/partial/wrong subject/device/epoch, preserve original CAS/idempotency and default-off. No public reserve/launch enablement, live provider/browser, main or deployment. Require focused genuine .NET11 Release + independent review before any subsequent activation task.

Create a separate minimal P1 task for post-CAS Challenge -> WorkWake hint binding, not a new wake/requeue implementation. Client/Modules/ChallengeWorkflow.fs:774-870 already performs canonical reverse-index wake/requeue with exact generation on resolve; blockAttempt :1677 and explicit requeueAttempt :1795 already exist. Client/Modules/WorkQueueReactiveWake.fs:14 defines DependencyCommitted but source-wide Client search shows no consumer, and WorkQueueSchedulerHostLoop.productionPorts has no caller. Hook only a confirmed original canonical Challenge/attempt CAS commit through a default-off host-owned bounded hint/notify or deterministic rescan; never on attempted/failed/unknown commit, no duplicate original effect or hidden start. Stale/no-index/duplicate/unknown CAS negative tests, no provider sends, no scheduler activation, isolated private source and independent review. W23 adjudication covers isolated test proof separately; do not conflate.
